instruction: A brisk, natural male tech host with a General American accent, speaking directly to one listener. Keep the same pace, energy, and vocal register throughout, around 220 words per minute.
opening_instruction: Say the opening in one connected breath, flowing through I'm Goo and immediately on through the show name. Carry that rhythm straight into {transition}, with only a tiny beat after the show name.
reading_instruction: Use short sentence gaps and conversational question intonation. Goo has a hard G and rhymes with too. Lemme sounds like lem-ee. Read the script verbatim.
